mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a short-term sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates weakening aggregate demand, which forecasts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns with a Rank IC below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production declines by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals manufacturing sector weakness that compresses corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO declines by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment over the past 3 months indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS has increased for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a tightening monetary policy cycle that reduces corporate borrowing and consumer demand, forecasting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and declining RSAFS fails to predict negative 20-day returns with a Rank IC below 0.04 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions with high housing starts (HOUST > 1800) and strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 650000), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 5 trading days due to overvaluation and profit-taking.
regime_hint: late-cycle expansion with high housing and consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1800 and RSAFS > 650000.
